notes.text: Percy Cottage, Rugby, TN. I dreew the plans at UT that got this project funded. Then I went to Nashville to create the working drawings.Percy Cottage is a charming, historically reconstructed 3-bedroom vacation rental located in the heart of Historic Rugby, an 1880s British-founded utopian village in Tennessee on the Cumberland Plateau. Named after Percy Kimber, son of early investor Sir Henry Kimber, it sits steps from the visitor center, library, and church
